New DraftKings customers, place a first-time bet of $5 or more and get $200 in Bonus Bets! And receive 3 months of NBA League Pass on us!

To be eligible for DraftKings Sportsbook and the Promotion, you must be physically located in AR, AZ, CO, CT, DC, IA, IL, IN, KS, KY, LA (select parishes), MA, MD, ME, MI, MO, NC, NJ, NH, NY, OH, OR, PA, PR (residents only), TN, VA, VT, WY, WV, CA-ONT or CA-AB (each an “Eligible Jurisdiction” or, collectively, the “Eligible Jurisdictions”). Must be 21+ years of age or older (18+ if in DC/NH/PR/WY/CA-AB) (19+ in CA-ONT).

A new DraftKings Sportsbook customer is defined as a customer who has never placed a wager on DraftKings Sportsbook.

Any customer who is found to be ineligible to participate on any DraftKings platform, including DraftKings Sportsbook (i.e., by way of self-exclusion, restriction due to employment, or otherwise) may not participate in this Promotion and immediately forfeits any bonus rewards which have been awarded under this Promotion. In addition to the eligibility requirements set forth above and in the Terms, to participate in the Promotion, customers must (1) be a new DraftKings customer as defined above, and (2) place a first-time bet of $5 or more on any eligible DraftKings Sportsbook market during the Promotional Period (the “Qualifying Bet”).

Qualified customers must place a minimum Qualifying Bet of $5. Qualifying Bets are bets on any available DraftKings Sportsbook market. Upon completion of the Promotion requirements and Qualifying Bet, qualified customers will receive:

(a) $50 in Bonus Bets. Customers will be eligible to receive an additional $50 in Bonus Bets every seven (7) days over the next twenty-one (21) days after completing the Promotion requirements. Maximum reward of $200 in Bonus Bets, issued as eight (8) $25 Bonus Bets over 21 days.

(b) One (1) promo code to redeem a complimentary 3-month subscription to NBA League Pass. As detailed below, promo code will be delivered via the email associated with the customer’s DraftKings account, and via in-app carousel and notification. NBA League Pass eligibility is determined by the NBA Media Ventures, as outlined below. Code to be delivered instantly upon placing Qualifying Bet, or in the event of technical difficulties, within 72 business hours.

$50 in Bonus Bets will be issued as two (2) $25 Bonus Bets upon completion of Promotion requirements and placement of Qualifying Bet. - Day 7: $50 in Bonus Bets issued via click-to-claim, $100 in Bonus Bets remain to be issued
- Day 14: $50 in Bonus Bets issued via click-to-claim, $50 in Bonus Bets remain to be issued
